definitions.explanation: Something happens without anticipation or intention. Often carries a sense of pleasant or neutral surprise.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけず⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I unexpectedly ran into an old friend.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけず⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I was very happy to receive a gift unexpectedly.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけず⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: It unexpectedly took a long time.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (thought) + がけ (expectation) + ず (negation)

Literally 'without expecting.'
- {思|おも}いがけない - unexpected (adjective)
- ⟦{思|おも}いがけなく→思いがけない：19375_omoigakenai⟧ - unexpectedly (adverb form)

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Literary flavor.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧/⟦{案外|あんがい}→案外：01699_angai⟧ - unexpectedly (focuses on result being different than expected)
- たまたま - by chance, coincidentally
- ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧ - suddenly, casually (for thoughts or actions)
